text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Your hands are looking
a bit rough, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is the detergent I'm using too strong?
Maybe I should try putting on rubber gloves...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"—N-No way!
What am I getting cold feet for?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't that mean
running away from a one-on-one showdown with laundry?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I'll see it through to the end!
I'll scrub every last bit with my bare hands!

As a result of her stubbornness...
Hishi Amazon suffered from rough, chapped hands for quite a while.
